name: Переписывание текста
description: Переписать текст с целью: упростить, SEO, смена тона, сократить, формализовать — с сохранением смысла

slots.label: Желаемый тон
slots.description: Например: профессиональный, дружелюбный,Authoritative — задайте, если цель — смена тона

rules.append: SEO note: keep the main keyword in the first sentence and in one subheading; do not stuff keywords.
Simplicity note: plain language a 12-year-old could follow, one idea per sentence, active voice.
Formal note: business writing conventions, no colloquialisms, precise terminology, no exclamation marks.
Shortening note: cut 40-60% of the length while keeping all key facts and the original conclusion.

examples:
Rewrite the text in русском.
Goal: simplify
Desired tone: friendly

Rules:
- Preserve the original meaning and every fact; do not invent details or numbers.
- Improve structure and flow; remove filler and repetitions.
- Keep proper nouns, numbers, and links intact.
- Return only the rewritten text without commentary.
